# Handle partial failure and idempotency with structured errors per chunk or article

**Group:** Article Analysis Agent (`article-analysis-agent`)

## Summary

Ensures one article or one POST chunk failing does not unnecessarily fail the entire run when partial success mode applies, consistent with data-collection hardening philosophy. Clarifies idempotency: default runs skip already analyzed sources via GET `unanalyzed=true` when `reanalyze` is false, reanalyze runs with bounds upsert mentions and relevance per API behavior without duplicating rows.

## Scope

- In scope: Per-article or per-chunk error isolation configuration. On LLM failure, mark affected articles failed with diagnostic context and continue when partial mode is enabled. On POST partial failure, surface API errors, do not claim success for counts the API did not confirm (FR7, Error Handling). Retry policy for transient errors if consistent with other agents. Document merge behavior for reanalyze with MP-ART-ANALYSIS-001 handler.
- Out of scope: New operator policy UI for discard versus rollback of prior chunks beyond logging and metrics.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Partial failure behavior matches documented mode (for example continue after recoverable extraction failure when enabled).
- [x] Successful chunks before a failed chunk are not reported as failed in aggregate metrics.
- [ ] Re-run with `reanalyze=false` does not reprocess already analyzed rows per GET semantics.
- [ ] Re-run with `reanalyze=true` and bounds overwrites or upserts per API without duplicate primary rows for the same logical keys.
- [ ] Structured logs or errors identify failing `dataSourceId` or chunk index without leaking secrets or full article body.
- [ ] Unit or integration tests cover partial failure and idempotent GET skip paths.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-006
- Blocks: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-008

## Notes

Coordinate exact upsert semantics with MP-ART-ANALYSIS-001 Prisma implementation. Align with PRD POST partial failure wording: surface API error and avoid false success claims.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/article-analysis-agent-prd.md
